title: Urad Dal
subtitle: white lentils with spiced onion and cumin
description: Split white urad lentils cooked soft with ginger, then topped with onion, chilli and cumin fried in ghee. Yellow or orange lentils can replace the urad.

steps.text: Rinse the lentils. Place in a pot with the water, salt and a 3 cm slice of chopped fresh ginger and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat and cook for 15-20 minutes until very soft, like rice. This stage can be done a few hours ahead.
Close to serving, heat the ghee in a pan and saute the chopped onion for 5 minutes until lightly golden. Add the whole chillies and cumin seeds and saute for half a minute or until fragrant.
Pour the spiced onion mixture over the hot cooked lentils, stir and serve, with rice if you like.
